niche_candidates.falsifiable_need: A compact text-forward investigation game with a coherent mystery and complete story could attract comparable interest with explicitly bounded authoring hours.
niche_candidates.public_attention_signal: Mystery & Noir category 726 titles within 2025 VN sitemap study
niche_candidates.required_commercial_test: Seller-authorized settled premium orders per matched eligible page visit and labor valued per title, controlling for prior fanbase and release age.

niche_candidates.falsifiable_need: Audience attention to dark romance traits might translate to voluntary paid readership for newly published small VNs under the same availability and age policy.
niche_candidates.public_attention_signal: 92 of 510 Otome & Dark Romance VNs had 50+ ratings; 48 of those tagged Yandere.
niche_candidates.required_commercial_test: Matched first-time publisher cohort by release age, comparable price/language, zero-order inclusion, developer hours and retained positive-price orders.

niche_candidates.falsifiable_need: A short offline puzzle with accessible controls and clear completion state could differentiate on usability, not on inferred demand from puzzle tags.
niche_candidates.public_attention_signal: 7,456 Puzzle-genre paid-filter listings; 2025 high-rated Dragonsweeper in independent study, but no paid order data.
niche_candidates.required_commercial_test: Same-priced matched puzzle cohorts, owner-authorized paid orders, refund/cost ledger and age distribution.

sampling_contract.population: first eligible newly priced indie game projects stratified by genre, product length, owner portfolio and team size

non_inferences: A 50+ rating threshold is not a transaction count, paying buyer number or marketwide hit rate.
Public ranking, genre tags and ratings do not reveal price actually paid, platform payout or labor-valued profit.
Overlapping manually clustered tags cannot be summed into mutually exclusive market shares.
Visual novel self-selection, existing fanbases, adult classification and outside publicity confound observed rating differences.
Observed VN content tags are not evidence that a niche game can be developed for zero cost or sold legally in all countries.
Later studies with different source frames cannot be added or compared without time and indexing controls.
